blockedBy.detail: The independent host script had a 30-minute watchdog. E1 reached the last assignment and was killed before executePlan wrote the receipt; the model run itself was still making progress.
blockedBy.fixApplied: scripts/trial-host-run.mjs now uses a 4-hour watchdog for execute runs. The change is not retroactive for this attempt.

progressAtTimeout.note: Host Executor acceptance is returned in the receipt/outcome, not persisted in the execution store. No receipt exists, so no E1 acceptance result can be claimed or reconstructed as authoritative.

usageObserved.note: Token usage is real ledger evidence. Cost remains unknown (null), never 0.

otherGroups.E2: E2 chain smoke (one reuse_compact assignment) is GREEN; the official E2 9-trial full group was not started.

e2Smoke.reuse: step 2 resumed the same writer session

actionsTaken: Ran the derived E2 chain smoke first: GREEN, including prerequisite, two ordered chain steps, same-session resume, unique graph nodes, Runner verdict and collector consumption.
Started full E1 with the authorized desktop profile, node executable and maxUsd=12.
Stopped after the host watchdog killed the process at 30 minutes; did not start E2/E3 full.
Did not retry E1: a second full run would repeat the already-executed frozen conditions and spend beyond the single authorized group budget without a reliable receipt.
Did not widen acceptance or invent a receipt.

fullRunDecision.reason: E1 has no authoritative receipt after an infrastructure timeout. Full E1/E2/E3 must not be continued until the operator authorizes a fresh run (or a defined resume/recovery policy) with the longer watchdog.
